usage: 航班 is used to refer to a scheduled commercial flight between airports.
You can use 航班 when talking about arrival or departure times at an airport.
The word 航班 can be followed by a number to specify a particular flight, e.g., 航班123 (flight 123).
航班 is commonly used in announcements, timetables, and travel conversations.
It can also be used when checking or booking flights on travel apps or at counters.
